batch_node.name: FedRAMP 20x KSI Catalog Hourly Schedule v0.2.0
batch_node.description: Seeds a Schedule that runs the FedRAMP 20x KSI Catalog collector once per hour at minute 17 UTC (off the top of the hour, where most schedules fire). The SCHEDULED_TARGET edge points at the KSI catalog collector's one not-configurable run configuration, seeded in run-configuration.grift.json (req-tap-cares-runconfig-selection-1). Schedules are user-creatable per req-tap-cares-scheduler-model-6, so this is a normal node create, not an INTERNAL_ONLY trusted-internal write.
